instruction: Gallery Pavilion Drawing Set Start from a blank Archicad project with no init files or local reference images. Build or edit the model using Archicad BIM elements, not visual-only placeholder geometry. Save the completed deliverables in the output folder as result.ifc and result.pdf. Create a single-storey BIM model for the named project. Keep the shaped model within 0.1 m of horizontal extents about X 0 to 12 and Y 0 to 8, with vertical extents about Z 0 to 3.6. Export result.ifc as an IFC4 model with unique GlobalId values for IFC root objects. It must contain exactly 1 building storey and exactly 5 IfcSpace zones named FOYER, GALLERY, BACK-OF-HOUSE, STORE, and WC. Assign every listed space to the single building storey. Use the southwest exterior corner as X=0, Y=0. Place FOYER from X=0 to 4 and Y=0 to 3, target area 12 m2; GALLERY from X=4 to 12 and Y=0 to 6, target area 48 m2; BACK-OF-HOUSE from X=0 to 4 and Y=3 to 6, target area 12 m2; STORE from X=0 to 3 and Y=6 to 8, target area 6 m2; WC from X=3 to 5 and Y=6 to 8, target area 4 m2. Model the required construction as real BIM element classes, including at least 8 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 1 IfcSlab element, and at least 1 IfcRoof element. If an equivalent exporter writes IfcWallStandardCase for walls, that is acceptable. Do not count IfcBuildingElementProxy or other generic proxy objects as satisfying required walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, doors, windows, or spaces. Publish result.pdf as a 2-page drawing set. The visible sheet text must include A101, A201, FLOOR PLAN, SECTION, GALLERY PAVILION, FOYER, GALLERY, and STORE so the title, drawing type, and key rooms or zones are identifiable. Other materials, colors, object names, property sets, layer names, relationship nesting, and IFC representation details may vary as long as the required BIM elements, spatial relationships, geometry ranges, schedules, and sheet text are present.
